notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.2 prints '{ SUM { identifier-1 } … [ UPON { data-name-1 } … ] } … [ RESET ON { data-name-2 | FINAL } ]', identifier-1 referencing a numeric data item (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1): no OF word, no arithmetic-expression or literal addend, no ROUNDED phrase. reportSumGroup/reportSumClause parse the 2023 superset ('SUM OF', reportValueOperand = arithmetic-expression, roundedPhrase) and BindSumClause/SumAddendRef/ResolveSumAddend bind it with no edition arm, and VersionConformancePass has no SUM visitor (VisitReportSourceClause gates the same operand only for SOURCE), so at 85 SUM OF WS-A, SUM WS-A + 1, SUM (WS-A), SUM 5, SUM ZERO, SUM FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-T) and SUM WS-A ROUNDED compile and run. The 1985 forms conform: probes at 85 with two DTL and one DT2 GENERATE: SUM WS-A -00036, SUM WS-A WS-B / 'WS-A, WS-B' -00015, UPON DTL -00024, UPON DTL DT2 00021, a repeated SUM group -00017, RESET ON FINAL -00036, a same-group crossfoot -00015, -ZZ,ZZ9 '-    36', X(4) subject '0021', S9V99 '-003.75', 17-digit addend into 18-digit counter; bare SUM, 'SUM UPON DTL' (the witness), empty UPON and RESET ON COBOL0001, alphanumeric addend COBOL2045, alphabetic subject COBOL2750. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-49.json).

next.reason: 1985: '{SUM {identifier-1} ... [UPON {data-name-1} ...]} ... [RESET ON {data-name-2|FINAL}]', identifier-1 a numeric item or a Report Section sum counter (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1, which lets that sum counter be 'in the same report group that contains this SUM clause'). §2023:13.18.54.2 adds an optional OF, arithmetic-expression-1 addends (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR1) and a rounded-phrase, and splits the addend: a Report Section item is data-name-1 (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4), any other item identifier-1 (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR5). SR4 b) also requires a data-name-1 in the same report group to 'be a repeating item', so a 1985 same-group crossfoot of non-repeating sum counters is refused. CHANGED (looser and stricter).
